author: 9to5Google
description:
The Fitbit Air is six months old, so here's my long-term review: every update Google has shipped since launch, from 100+ activity detection to Health Guardian trends in the Google Health app, plus what's coming next, like Android XR gesture controls. After wearing it every day and night since launch, I break down whether this $99 screenless fitness tracker is still the best subscription-free alternative to Whoop and the Pixel Watch for sleep, heart rate and workout tracking.
